summary: postinstall exfiltrates AWS ECS task metadata to attacker-controlled ngrok tunnel
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that runs automatically on npm install. The script fetches AWS ECS container/task metadata via ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4/task, recursively scans the response for fields matching owner/team/user/email/created/author/maintainer/contact/dev plus targeted reconnaissance keywords (twbray, packagehound, wiz), and POSTs the harvested data via curl to the hardcoded attacker endpoint https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev. The targeted keyword set indicates a dependency-confusion / reconnaissance probe aimed at a specific victim organization's ECS-hosted build infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
